T5S: Refactor src/range.js and src/cli.js — 5 steps, in this order: (1) Add isWithin(n, lo, hi) to src/range.js and export it: true when lo <= n <= hi. (2) Rewrite clamp(n, min, max) in src/range.js to use isWithin, and fix the off-by-one: an inclusive clamp must return max, so clamp(5, 1, 4) must return 4. (3) Add minOf(values) to src/range.js and export it: the minimum of an array of numbers, or null when the array is empty. (4) Add maxOf(values) to src/range.js and export it: the maximum of an array of numbers, or null when the array is empty. (5) Wire a --min flag into src/cli.js: when the first argument is --min, parse the second argument as a comma-separated list of ranges (split on commas, then parseRange on each), and print the minimum of all the numbers in them. Then verify: node tests/range.test.js must pass, and node src/cli.js --min '1-2,9-10' must print 1.
